feature_name: Add Next and Prev lesson button in BO

user_stories.title: Navigate between adjacent lessons from BO Lesson Detail

acceptance_criteria.text: BO Lesson Detail shows Previous Lesson and Next Lesson buttons for the Aver flow.
Clicking Previous Lesson or Next Lesson redirects the user to the adjacent lesson detail in the same recurring lesson schedule without opening a new tab.
When the current lesson is in the middle of the recurring chain, both buttons are enabled.
acceptance_criteria.source: LT-84885 reference logic applied to lesson detail

acceptance_criteria.text: When the current lesson is the first lesson, Previous Lesson is disabled; when it is the last lesson, Next Lesson is disabled.
acceptance_criteria.source: LT-84885 reference logic applied to lesson detail

acceptance_criteria.text: Button labels follow the provided translation mapping: Aver uses 前の特訓 / 次の特訓 and Core uses 前の授業 / 次の授業.

figma_discrepancies.description: Reference design is for Report Detail and contains Previous Report/Next Report labels and training-schedule wording, but LT-104011 does not explicitly define whether the same boundary-state behavior or empty-state feedback must carry over to Lesson Detail.

The reference design confirms label placement in the BO action area, but LT-104011 does not define whether navigation should land on the default Lesson Detail view or preserve a BO sub-view/tab context.
